Definition: from G1223 and a derivative of G5345; to report thoroughly, i.e. divulgate:--blaze abroad, commonly report, spread abroad, fame.
BiblicalUsage: To spread abroad is what happens to news no one can keep quiet. The leper Jesus healed spreads the report everywhere, the fame of the blind men who were healed goes through all the land, and the soldiers spread the lie about the empty tomb for money.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that news always spreads, and the question is which news I spread. The healed could not keep silent about Jesus, and the soldiers were paid to lie about Him, and I must choose whose report I carry.
